title: Lab 1B — Secrets Manager + Cognito config
topic: Secrets Manager vs SSM Parameter Store, GetSecretValue + kms:Decrypt, Cognito wiki auth, Lambda env COGNITO_SECRET_ARN, least-privilege IAM
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces Night 3 saa-study/gsa-wiki-cognito secret lab. Answer without night-3-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×2 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: A wiki API stores Cognito pool ID, client ID, and region in Secrets Manager. Why not paste those values directly into Lambda environment variables?

options.A: Lambda environment variables cannot exceed 128 characters total per function
options.B: Cognito rejects tokens when client IDs are supplied via environment variables
options.C: CloudFront requires Secrets Manager for all origin custom header values
options.D: Plaintext env vars appear in console/logs; Secrets Manager supports rotation and audit

questions.question: A Lambda role has GetSecretValue on one secret ARN plus kms:Decrypt on the CMK. GetSecretValue still fails with AccessDeniedException. What is the first check?

options.A: Whether the secret's KMS key policy allows the Lambda role to decrypt with the CMK
options.B: Whether API Gateway must assume the Lambda role before each GET request arrives
options.C: Whether Cognito user pool requires MFA for all anonymous wiki page read traffic
options.D: Whether DynamoDB streams must be enabled on the wiki table before GetSecretValue

questions.question: When should you pick Secrets Manager over SSM Parameter Store Standard String?

options.A: Always — Parameter Store cannot hold JSON configuration documents at all
options.B: When you need automatic rotation hooks and native secret versioning for credentials
options.C: When the value is public CloudFront cache metadata that never changes
options.D: When you need free unlimited API calls with no encryption option available

questions.question: SSM Parameter Store SecureString with a KMS CMK is contrasted with Secrets Manager. Which statement is accurate?

options.A: SecureString cannot use KMS encryption for parameter values stored at rest
options.B: Parameter Store replaces Cognito for wiki JWT validation end to end
options.C: Both can encrypt with KMS; Secrets Manager adds rotation built for secrets
options.D: SecureString requires a VPC endpoint; Secrets Manager never needs one

questions.question: A Lambda sets COGNITO_SECRET_ARN in environment variables and calls GetSecretValue at runtime. What does the env var hold?

options.A: The ARN of the secret — not the password or Cognito client secret itself
options.B: The Cognito client secret plaintext used directly for JWT signature validation
options.C: The KMS CMK plaintext key material for envelope encryption of responses
options.D: The DynamoDB stream ARN for wiki page change capture and fan-out

questions.question: An engineer says KMS already stores the Cognito client secret because the secret is encrypted with a CMK. What is wrong with that statement?

options.A: Nothing — KMS stores all application secrets whenever SSE-KMS encryption is enabled
options.B: Cognito stores secrets only in user pool Lambda triggers, not in KMS
options.C: CloudTrail stores secrets in log files encrypted with the CMK instead
options.D: KMS manages encryption keys; Secrets Manager stores the secret value itself

questions.question: Anonymous users GET wiki pages; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require a valid Cognito JWT. Where does the Lambda validate the token?

options.A: CloudFront Function at the edge — Lambda never receives Authorization headers at all
options.B: S3 bucket policy Condition on cognito:username for each object key path
options.C: API Lambda using Cognito JWKS after reading pool config from Secrets Manager
options.D: DynamoDB fine-grained access control on the partition key only for writers

questions.question: You tighten GetSecretValue from secretsmanager:* on * to one secret ARN. aws iam simulate-principal-policy shows allowed. What does this prove?

options.A: The secret value is now rotated automatically every hour by AWS without further setup
options.B: CloudWatch Logs will no longer record GetSecretValue API calls at all
options.C: Cognito will reject tokens from other user pools automatically after the change
options.D: The role can fetch that secret under current policies if KMS also allows decrypt

questions.question: A bastion EC2 instance in a private subnet is used for admin SSH. Which service provides shell access without a bastion or open SSH port?

options.A: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager — shell via SSM agent without inbound SSH
options.B: Amazon Cognito hosted UI — browser login replaces SSH and EC2 instance shell access
options.C: AWS Secrets Manager rotation Lambda — injects SSH keys into the instance
options.D: CloudFront signed URLs — temporary links open an SSH tunnel to the host

questions.question: A Secrets Manager secret is encrypted with a customer CMK. Deleting the CMK immediately would cause what?

options.A: Only CloudFront cache miss — Secrets Manager keeps plaintext secret copies in memory
options.B: GetSecretValue fails — secret ciphertext cannot be decrypted without a valid CMK
options.C: Cognito user pool is deleted automatically when the CMK enters pending deletion
options.D: Lambda environment variables revert to legacy plaintext Cognito config names
